<thought>Search for a retrosynthetic template that corresponds to the Peterson reaction, which in the forward direction converts a β‑hydroxy‑silane into an alkene, breaking a C‑O bond (forming an alcohol) and a C‑Si bond (forming a trimethylsilyl group) and forming a C=C double bond. In the retrosynthetic direction we need a template that breaks a C‑C double bond and forms an aldehyde (or ketone) and a trimethylsilyl group. Using the available functional group names, we will search for templates with the broken group “C‑C double bonds” and the formed groups “aldehydes” and “trimethylsilyl”.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "C=C(C1=CC=C(OC)C=C1)C2=CC=C(OC)C=C2",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["C-C double bonds"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["aldehydes", "trimethylsilyl"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
